castingGroups.appearanceFromSource: John is 33, described as a young-looking white/Caucasian man in a dark-blue suit at his first present-day entrance. No celebrity or existing-project face is selected.
castingGroups.roleContext: Lead detective: professionally abrasive, tender with Jill, protective toward Diego, increasingly exhausted and frightened. Jack has British delivery, raised brows and more proper posture; Johnny has a thick Boston delivery and an assertive, amused performance. They share one physical body. The concealed alley assailant uses this body without revealing its face.
castingGroups.request: Ten distinct base candidates for the adult body; for each base candidate make one identity-matched Jack performance portrait and one identity-matched Johnny portrait. Ten matched options per speaking state, not thirty unrelated people.

castingGroups.appearanceFromSource: Boy aged 15. He is the younger form of adult John, established by the later story. No hairstyle or clothing is specified.
castingGroups.roleContext: Finds his mother dead, resists the abusive man and addresses an unseen Johnny after the gunshot. The casting image is a neutral, age-appropriate portrait with no violence or distress enactment.
castingGroups.request: Ten adolescent candidates; later reconcile resemblance with the chosen adult. Do not create a second visible child named Johnny.

castingGroups.appearanceFromSource: Adult man; no age, appearance or wardrobe supplied. A separate person from the later hostage man.
castingGroups.roleContext: The abusive man in the childhood opening; his taunting establishes the boy's fear and anger. Explore credible faces without making facial traits a shorthand for villainy.
castingGroups.request: Ten distinct neutral casting portraits, without weapons or injuries.

castingGroups.appearanceFromSource: Female officer with long thick hair in a bun and rubber gloves in the crime scene. Age and ethnicity not stated.
castingGroups.roleContext: Competent colleague handling the body and sample. Can be gently teasing, then direct about John's exhaustion. Explore grounded presence, not a generic glamour model.
castingGroups.request: Ten distinct candidates; neutral portrait and source-appropriate work styling.

castingGroups.appearanceFromSource: 28, young-looking Hispanic man in a black suit. Later wears a vest in the hostage flashback.
castingGroups.roleContext: John's partner, loyal friend and increasingly concerned observer. Banter, personal conviction and a sincere wish to save John matter more than a stock sidekick look.
castingGroups.request: Ten distinct adult candidates within the written age/identity; do not stereotype ethnicity.

castingGroups.appearanceFromSource: Bald man, explicit age 50, described as appearing older than his late fifties; wrinkled shirt and loose, off-centre tie at first entrance. Preserve this apparent-age discrepancy in metadata.
castingGroups.roleContext: Pressured captain, initially protective of John, forced to suspend him and later confronting what he missed. Needs authority and fatigue without comic caricature.
castingGroups.request: Ten distinct mature candidates; broad apparent-age exploration consistent with looking older than the stated age.

castingGroups.appearanceFromSource: 29, red hair and green eyes. Birthday hat/cupcake are scene props, not permanent identity features.
